title.zh: PVSSPW · 基于 Vitaslop 的网页版 PS Vita 模拟器与性能对测平台
title.en: PVSSPW · WebAssembly PS Vita Emulator Workbench & Benchmark Suite

summary.zh: 在手机与桌面浏览器上运行的网页端 PS Vita 模拟器与对测工作台，集成修复版 Vitaslop（libsas 覆盖、SMP 多线程、FSR 1 与 FrameFlow GameFI 插帧 / GameSR 2× 超分）及 Vita3K Web 对照评测流水线。
summary.en: Browser PlayStation Vita emulator workbench and benchmark suite integrating patched Vitaslop (libsas, SMP worker pool, FSR 1, FrameFlow GameFI interpolation and GameSR 2x SR) alongside reproducible Vita3K Web comparisons.

zh: 在锁定版 Vitaslop 基础上修复 ARM 跳转表与协程信号唤醒，构建单/多线程 Wasm 并支持每局并行 CPU 测速选线程（如 Intel Xe-LPG 3 线程战斗 21.99 FPS）
复用 PPSSPW 风格纯浏览器工作台界面，支持 ZIP/VPK 导入、HTTP Range 206 断点清单下载、rePatch/附加内容管理与逐游戏/全局存档 ZIP 导出恢复
集成基于 WebGPU 零拷贝共享设备的 FSR 1 空间超分、GameFI 光流插帧（2×/3×）与 GameSR 2× 超分，可独立开启或串联使用
配套 Playwright 无头 Edge/Chromium 与 Android Firefox/Chromium 自动化冷启动、首帧、600 秒战斗帧率及像素采样评测流水线
en: Patches locked Vitaslop to resolve ARM jump-table and thread-signal wakeups, supporting single- and multi-threaded Wasm builds with per-session thread-pool benchmarking
Provides a unified browser workbench UI with ZIP/VPK library imports, HTTP Range 206 resumable downloads, rePatch/DLC management, and confirmed per-game/full save ZIP export and restore
Integrates zero-copy shared-GPUDevice WebGPU post-processing: FSR 1 spatial scaling, FrameFlow GameFI optical-flow frame interpolation (2x/3x), and GameSR 2x neural super-resolution
Includes reproducible headless Edge/Chromium and Android WebDriver/CDP benchmarks measuring cold start, first frame, 600-second sustained battle FPS, and per-pixel frame updates

roadmap.stage: 实验阶段 · 持续调优

milestone.zh: 已完成修复版 Vitaslop 网页工作台、FSR 1 与 FrameFlow（GameFI 插帧 + GameSR 2× 超分）零拷贝集成及无头 Edge 工作台验证；实体 Android/iOS 设备实测持续补齐中。
milestone.en: Patched Vitaslop browser workbench, zero-copy FSR 1 and FrameFlow (GameFI + GameSR 2x) integration, and headless Edge verification are complete; physical mobile device measurements remain ongoing.
